name: button-impact-shockwave
intent: Angular shockwave echoes expand from button origin to card edges — sharp hex rings, not soft ripple.

reducedMotion.behaviour: COMPLETE appears immediately; no ring expansion or card nudge

acceptance: Idle: PRIORITY card with Activate button; live reads action ready
Activate: three angular hex rings echo from button centre to card edges
Rings hold full opacity until 85% then cut off — no soft Material fade
Card nudges on impact; COMPLETE label appears
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) skips ring animation
No network; effect stays inside host panel
waveB: Origin percentages, echo count (3), and max scale frozen in contract — angular not ripple
